skills.name: Absorption (吸取/吸収)
skills.description: Hotarugusa focuses her magical power and attacks a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and inflicts 30% of HP Steal.

skills.name: Flower Power (生花/薬草)
skills.line: Where there's a will, there is a way!
skills.description:
When Hotarugusa is attacked, restores her HP by 15% of her ATK. Only triggers once for multi-stage attacks.
If the source of the damage has lower ATK than Hotarugusa, decreases her damage received by 30%.

skills.name: Healing Light (治愈之光/癒しの光)
skills.line: Hear me, gods!Grant me the power to heal!
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Hotarugusa carries 2 Blessed Seeds at the start of battle. Each Blessed Seed increases her ATK by 60%. ;Upon Usage :Grants a Blessed Seed to an ally before restoring the HP of all allies by 87% of her ATK. ; : ;Blessed Seed (祝福の種) : :'''General, Status''': After granting it to an ally and when she has her HP restored, she restores the HP of the ally by an equal amount of HP. ;Photosynthesis (光合成) : :'''Buff, Status''': Restores the ally's HP after they take an action. Converts the first hit indirect damage taken each turn into an equal amount of restored HP.
